run_glue_task: run GLUE training and evaluation on a specified NLP task like MNLI or SST-2
load_glue_data: load binarized GLUE dataset with labels for train, validation, and test splits
train_glue_model: finetune an embedder with a projection layer on GLUE training data for one epoch
eval_glue_model: evaluate a trained GLUE model on validation or test set and compute accuracy, F1, or correlation scores
build_glue_iterator: build a data iterator for GLUE train, validation, or test splits with optional shuffling
